explanation: Kolberg (Math. Scand. 1959): p(n) is even for infinitely many n and odd for infinitely many n. This is the classical result (also a consequence of Subbarao's conjecture, proved by Ono and Radu, as recalled in Ono–Swaminathan arXiv:2509.09553 §1). The formal statement uses Mathlib's partitionNumber and asserts both sets are infinite. Faithful.
